title: ED questions Veena for around 8 hours in CMRL pay-off case
description: ED is learnt to have asked her about the payments amounting to ₹2.78 crore made by CMRL to her now-defunct Exalogic IT company. The ED also raised questions on the loans worth ₹50 lakh extended to Exalogic by a firm operated by CMRL Managing Director S.N. Sasidharan Kartha, despite her company failing to make timely repayments
